# Source stereo fixtures

These small, unchanged MOL records are copied from independently frozen evidence.
Known allene Cartesian poses are literal analytic positive/negative controls;
known 2D depictions inherit their frozen analytic sign. Unknown tetrahedral and
mixed poses come from the independently reviewed v2 corpus. Unknown allene poses
are actual raw OCL embeddings, with the existing explicit UFF energy-only option;
no relaxation, geometry adjustment, or generated expected value was used.

Tests exercise ordinary import/reopen only. These fixtures do not establish
optimization quality, automatic preparation, absolute axial R/S nomenclature, or
cross-tool interpretation of allene stereochemistry.
